sources.title: Towards an improved understanding of glide-snow avalanche release: interface shear cold laboratory tests
sources.type: Primary ISSW proceedings; preliminary cold-laboratory experiments
sources.access: Full 5-page PDF; page746 methods visually inspected
sources.transfer_limit: Impermeable glass/sandpaper, 434Pa added normal stress; not LL grain bed. LWC denominator not equated to other papers. 8mm stopping description and >10mm residual discussion are not resolved into a fabricated common stroke.
sources.design_use: Separate snow cohesive failure, interface shear peak and residual resistance.

sources.title: Relationships between Surface Properties and Snow Adhesion and Its Shedding Mechanisms
sources.access: Publisher search/fulltext indexing and full original12page PDF copy; page3 visually inspected; raw supplement not obtained
sources.transfer_limit: 43.53±24.99um airborne generated particles before impact/agglomeration; neither natural snow size nor packed snow aggregate size. RMS roughness not interchangeable with Ra.
sources.design_use: Entry aperture and snow size must be matched; no universal roughness target.

sources.title: Shear and tensile adhesion of dry and wet snow on metallic surfaces
sources.access: Publisher abstract/highlights search index; direct403, fulltext and linked dataset not obtained
sources.transfer_limit: Aluminum surface finishes, not artificial firn. No imported strength values, LWC basis or full methods.
sources.design_use: Shear and tensile trends can oppose each other; do not substitute pull adhesion for slope shear.

sources.title: Thermal Insulation and Superhydrophobicity Synergies for Passive Snow Repellency
sources.access: Publisher abstract and SI descriptions through search index; direct403; fulltext not obtained
sources.transfer_limit: Snow-repellent sheets, not open granular substrate. Does not show LL is superhydrophobic or quantify our winter adhesion.
sources.design_use: Low heat transfer and low-wetting outer surface alone do not prove snow anchoring.

sources.title: Characteristics of snow gliding on rock
sources.access: Primary fulltext and PDF; abstract/site used only
sources.transfer_limit: Two winters at31degree rock slope, no transfer of glide speed or avalanche threshold.
sources.design_use: Winter verification includes time history and spatial weak zones, not a single cold adhesion peak.

notes: Source PDFs are referenced, not republished. Hashes identify temporarily inspected bytes. All design calculations are our own uncalibrated scenarios.
